sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233717, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: Single site $30, double site $60, group (tent-only) site $110 a night; additional vehicle $10 a night. Same rates in the 2026 and 2027 peak seasons.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/bowman-bridge-campground ('Single Site: $30 per night', 'Double Site: $60 per night', 'Group Site: $110 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $10 per vehicle per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233717/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-02 to 2026-10-12 and 2027-05-02 to 2027-10-12: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 30, double 60, GROUP TENT ONLY AREA NONELECTRIC 110), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: RIDB campsite catalog for 233717 (every family site typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC, no hookup attributes), read 2026-10-25

values.note: One loop of 16 paved family sites, plus 4 walk-in family sites and 4 tent-only group sites (up to 20 people each). The catalog lists 13 RV-capable family sites (7 reservable, 6 first-come), all back-in, max vehicle length 50 ft. Two vehicles or one RV per site, two camping units with only one wheeled; all tires must fit on the spur. Thinner shade than neighbouring campgrounds since a 2005 tornado.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233717 ('The campground has a single loop 16 paved family campsites. There are also 4 walk-in family campsites and 4 tent-only group sites'; notice 'Limit 2 vehicles or 1 RV per campsite ... only one can be wheeled ... All tires need to fit on the spurs!') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length 50 on all 13 RV sites; Driveway Entry Back-In), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Camp host, self-pay station, trash collection. Connector trail to the North Country National Scenic Trail; Bowman Bridge Boat Landing down the hill.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233717 (amenities: Vault Toilets, Drinking Water, Host, Self Pay Station, Trash Collection, Trailheads) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/bowman-bridge-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site', 'Located up the hill from Bowman Bridge Boat Landing, the campground also has a connector trail for the North Country National Scenic Trail'), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/bowman-bridge-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Early May - Mid October'; status 'Site Closed' on 2026-10-25), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov up to 4 days before arrival; 6 of the 13 family sites are first-come. Weekend reservations 2 nights. recreation.gov's stay rule is 16 consecutive nights. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. A watercraft permit is needed to float the Pere Marquette Memorial Day weekend - Labor Day weekend.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233717 (facility_rules: reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival', minWeekendStay 2, maxConsecutiveStay 16; notices 'This campground has first-come, first-serve sites', 'Check in time is 2:00pm and Check out time is 11:00am', watercraft permit notice) + RIDB catalog (6 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites not reservable), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Interagency Senior and Access passes give 50% off single campsites only (the site the pass holder occupies); enter the pass at booking.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/bowman-bridge-campground ('Interagency Senior and Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites only') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233717 ('Any accepted senior passes must be entered for the discount at the time of booking for single sites only'), read 2026-10-25

note: Manistee NF campground up the hill from Bowman Bridge Boat Landing on the Pere Marquette National Scenic River, ~5 mi west of Baldwin via W 52nd Street; concession-run (American Land & Leisure). Popular canoe and trout/steelhead fishing access; connector trail to the North Country Trail. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + RIDB catalog + FS page: $30 single (2026/2027, confirmed), no electric (confirmed), 16 paved family sites + 4 walk-in + 4 group tent sites (count 20 -> 16), 50-ft max back-in spurs, vault toilets/drinking water (confirmed), reservable on rec.gov (platform confirmed) with some first-come sites, 4-day cutoff, 2-night weekend minimum, 16-night stay rule, senior/access 50% off; season early May - mid October (note only). No alert affects the road. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Operator: concession-run by American Land & Leisure (rec.gov 'Customer Service Contact 801-226-3564 or Help.Huron.Manistee@AmericanLL.com'; 'For facility specific information, please call (801) 226-3564'). rec.gov's facility phone is 231-745-8760; the entry's 231-745-4631 is the Baldwin/White Cloud Ranger District number the FS page lists, so it was left.

Waterfront re-audit lead (weak): recreation.gov says 'The campground is situated along the Pere Marquette National Scenic River'; the FS page puts it 'up the hill from Bowman Bridge Boat Landing'. The entry has 'not waterfront'.
